postState.name: OMEGA-TEST: TPO Rotation to POC
postState.description: Inside the prior session's value area, price tends to rotate toward the prior point of control. Two required gates - inside prior value, and at least 0.25% of room to the prior POC - block anything else before the agent is billed. UP when the prior POC is above the close, DOWN when below. Prior-session columns only, so it is live all day. Routing weights and trade management mirror the vendor's validated 1h intraday fade playbook.
postState.tagline: Fade the edge of prior value back toward the prior point of control

section.title: TPO rotation to prior POC
section.text:
Positive spread means the first metric sits above the second. pTpoVAL: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAL_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs close. pTpoVAH: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAH_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs close. pTpoPOC: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC session. pTpoPOC_close_spread: % gap pTpoPOC vs close. pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs pTpoVAL. RSI14: 14-period relative strength index (0–100). CCI: 20-period commodity channel index (±100 reference). BBtouch: price contact with a Bollinger band (upper / lower / none). CVD: cumulative volume delta accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor. MFI14: 14-period money flow index (volume-weighted RSI, 0–100). donchianHi: the highest high of the last 20 closed bars — the Donchian channel's upper edge. donchianLo: the lowest low of the last 20 closed bars — the Donchian channel's lower edge. K: stochastic %K (14,3,3). D: stochastic %D — the %K signal line. ADX: 14-period average directional index (trend strength, 0–100).

Conditions are deterministic reads of your report columns, resolved server-side at prompt-build time. They are advisory: they may make you more selective, never less — they do not gate, score, or qualify anything. TRUE / FALSE / UNRESOLVED are three distinct states; UNRESOLVED means an input was missing, not that the read was false. A value marked (provisional) came from the live forming bar and can still change before that bar closes.
